transientBrandFailures.classification: The original 404 results were transient/rate-related observations; every URL was rechecked sequentially and returned 200 in production.

placeholderBrandFailures.classification: The placeholder route was a real defect. Invalid catalog slugs are now rejected before API lookup and excluded from sitemap generation.

method: Sequential public HTTPS recheck with 250 ms spacing; no full 4,648-URL rescan was required because every recorded failure was individually resolved.
limitation: This resolution closes the 15 recorded technical failures only; it is not a claim that every URL received full browser, visual, accessibility, or Google indexing acceptance.
